info.description: A pricing tier. The original's pricing page is three independent axes — use case, deployment and billing period — so a plan declares which combinations it belongs to rather than existing once per combination.

priceMonthly.description: USD per month. Null means the tier is free or quoted, which priceNote explains.

priceYearly.description: USD per month when billed yearly. The original advertises 'Save 10%'.

priceNote.description: Shown in place of a figure: 'Custom pricing', 'Free', 'Price starts at $20,000 / year'.

deployments.description: Which deployment toggles show this plan: ["cloud"], ["self-hosted"] or both.

footnoteSecondary.description: The second line under the button, e.g. '14 days free trial. Upgrade anytime.'

highlighted.description: The tier the original visually promotes.

useCases.description: Reuses the existing Business Intelligence / Embedded Analytics vocabulary rather than duplicating it as an enum.
